high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "thesciencekingdom." The post is titled "Reasons We May Live in a Multiverse" and features four different types of universes, each labeled with a unique name. Infinite Universe: This image depicts a vast, grid-like structure that appears to be a digital or abstract representation of space. The grid is illuminated with golden and yellow hues, giving it a glowing effect. The text "Infinite Universe" is written below the image. Bubble Universe: This image shows a cluster of blue, spherical bubbles against a dark background.
